items.description: Disposal of shed and tree debris
items.rationale: The storm-felled tree damaged the declared shed under §2.5.3(c). All four debris types qualify under §5.2.1(a)–(b), including the single root ball under 1 m³, so §7.1.10 permits the combined line; estimated disposal is €60 timber + €32 glass + €55 green waste + €45 root ball, excluding any duplicate haulage under §7.1.8(c).

items.description: Disposal of soil, topsoil and paving grit
items.rationale: Section 5.2.1(d) excludes all three ground materials, even after screening or displacement. This stand-alone disposal was not necessary for shed reinstatement and included no making good under §5.2.2; €120 is a conditional gross estimate only.
